name: Be With!
source:
Hero has not had his hair cut for three years due to fear of having ears cut off. When his sister finally managed to cut his hair, girls in the school started to look at him with interest. What kind of future will he choose?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-july-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公因为害怕耳朵被剪掉而三年没有理发。当妹妹终于成功帮他剪了头发后，学校里的女孩们开始对他投以兴趣的目光。他会选择怎样的未来？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-july-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
